messages.text: Hi - is the box in good condition? For a retired set that's most of what I'm paying for.
Yes, stored in a cupboard since new. The boxes are fine.
It arrived today. One box has a badly crushed corner, split right open. That isn't what I paid for.
It was in good condition when it left me. I packed it carefully.

listing.title: Four retired sets
listing.body: Used - like new. Boxes in good condition.
